_comment: Copy to projects.deploy.json (gitignored). One entry per project, keyed by its folder name in PROJECTS_DIR. `make new` writes entries for new projects; add entries by hand for apps you already host. A project with no entry (or enabled: false) is skipped by `make deploy`. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every field is optional.

_fields.enabled: false = never deploy this project (default true)
_fields.port: port the app listens on (127.0.0.1); used for PORT, the health check and the Caddy site
_fields.pm2Name: pm2 app name (default: the project name; null = no pm2 app)
_fields.dropletDir: the clone on the droplet (default: DROPLET_PROJECTS_DIR/<project>)
_fields.subdomain: served at <subdomain>.BASE_DOMAIN (default: lowercased project name; null = no Caddy site)
_fields.healthPath: path for the HTTP health check (default /); any status below 500 passes
_fields.build: shell command replacing the default `npm install` + `npm run build`; "" = no build step
_fields.start: command pm2 runs on the first deploy (default `npm start`), with PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1
_fields.deploy: shell command replacing build AND (re)start; runs in dropletDir as APP_USER after the pull. The health check still runs.
_fields.created: set by make new; make remove only deletes projects that have it

existing-python-app.notes: already running under pm2; deploy = pull + pm2 restart
